findings.criterion: `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the FULL gating suite (`make test`) pass
findings.detail: This criterion requires executing the full test/lint/typecheck suite and confirming it passes. The ticket has no comments and no attestation recording a passing CI run. The criterion is untagged (codebase-verifiable), but its evidence is inherently operational — it requires running commands. No CI badge, no committed run log, and no ticket comment records a passing result. The implementation looks complete and the tests are real, but I cannot confirm the suite passes from the repository alone.
findings.remediation: Record a passing `make lint && make typecheck && make test` run as a ticket comment (or confirm via the Gerrit Verified vote), naming the commit SHA and the run timestamp.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
